about: Sonic adventure 2 splits its campaign into speed stages (sonic and shadow), treasure hunts (knuckles and rouge) and mech shooting (tails and eggman), stitched by the hero-versus-dark story and a battle-of-the-arks finale. The chao garden is the meta-game that ate hundreds of hours, and city escape remains the series' most quoted track.

Sega shipped the dreamcast original in 2001; the steam listing (november 2012 windows port) is the current official door, still sold. The pc port is the battle edition - the dlc-rich 2002 gamecube re-release's content set.
The 2012 port is a light 3d renderer - the haswell igpu bar holds 1080p with settings to spare. Not-tested stands until a run confirms install, launch and saves.
